headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: July 6, 2026**
article:
The New York Mets secured a thrilling 10-9 victory over the Atlanta Braves, with Drake Baldwin leading the offense. In other action, the Pittsburgh Pirates cruised past the Washington Nationals 11-5, while the Cincinnati Reds edged the Baltimore Orioles 3-2. The Minnesota Twins took down the New York Yankees 6-1 behind Joe Ryan's 7.0 innings of shutout baseball.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, including Max Rajcic of the St. Louis Cardinals, who has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to right elbow soreness. Other notable injuries include Martín Pérez of the Atlanta Braves, Brandon Woodruff of the Milwaukee Brewers, Tomoyuki Sugano of the Colorado Rockies, Seth Halvorsen of the Colorado Rockies, Matt Gage of the San Francisco Giants, Ha-Seong Kim of the Atlanta Braves, and Jakob Junis of the Texas Rangers.

The New York Mets made a trade with the Detroit Tigers, acquiring right-handed pitcher Matt Seelinger for cash considerations. The Minnesota Twins also made a trade with the Detroit Tigers, acquiring right-handed pitcher Woo-Suk Go for cash. Additionally, the Cleveland Guardians acquired right-handed pitcher Ryan Degges from the Philadelphia Phillies for cash, while the Washington Nationals acquired left-handed pitcher Tom Cosgrove from the Houston Astros for cash.

top_news.title: **Mets Edge Braves in Thrilling 10-9 Victory**
top_news.summary: The New York Mets outlasted the Atlanta Braves in a back-and-forth contest, ultimately securing a 10-9 win. Drake Baldwin led the Mets' offense with a strong performance, collecting 2 hits, including a home run, and driving in 4 runs.

top_news.title: **Pirates Cruise Past Nationals 11-5**
top_news.summary: The Pittsburgh Pirates secured a convincing 11-5 victory over the Washington Nationals, with Brandon Lowe leading the offense. Lowe hit a home run and drove in three runs, while Eddy Yean pitched two scoreless innings in relief.

top_news.title: **Reds Edge Orioles in Thrilling Finish**
top_news.summary: The Cincinnati Reds secured a 3-2 victory over the Baltimore Orioles, with Nick Lodolo earning the win after 6.0 innings of work. Spencer Steer led the Reds' offense with a home run and 2 RBI.

top_news.title: **Twins Take Down Yankees 6-1**
top_news.summary: The Minnesota Twins secured a 6-1 victory over the New York Yankees, with Joe Ryan pitching 7.0 innings of shutout baseball. Ryan earned the win with 9 strikeouts and 1 walk.

top_news.title: **Cardinals' Rajcic Lands on Injured List**
top_news.summary: St. Louis Cardinals right-handed pitcher Max Rajcic has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to right elbow soreness, effective retroactive to July 4, 2026.

top_news.title: **Mets Acquire RHP Matt Seelinger in Trade**
top_news.summary: The New York Mets have acquired right-handed pitcher Matt Seelinger in a trade with the Detroit Tigers. The deal was made for cash considerations.
